note: Farinelli breathing paced by the breathwork tool (the text says only what to notice), then one long low Do over a drone on the same slow air. The key is moves (key any) with its line opening {{?key}}, and the feel to reach is a flat line for as long as the breath out.

exercise.title: Breathe, then hold Do
exercise.why: A note stays steady when the air under it does, so pace your breath first and then hold one note on the same slow air.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in, hold and breathe out as the circle grows, stays and shrinks, each for the count shown.
Keep your shoulders still and let your belly do the moving.

Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing the low {{1}} on the same slow air, and hold it while your line stays flat. Sing it on "oo".
Practice until the note lasts as long as a slow breath out, with the line flat to the end.
{{?key}}In another key the drone sits higher or lower, and the note to hold is still the drone's note.
